page: Microsoft Azure M96ds_1_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MDSMediumMemoryv3 family. Built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by Intel processors, this server provides 96 dedicated vCPUs. It features a substantial memory capacity of 974.0 GB, yielding approximately 10.15 GB of RAM per core. The virtualization environment is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

For local storage requirements, the instance includes a bundled 410 GB local SSD. Additionally, the server is Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external storage volumes to meet demanding input/output requirements. There are no integrated GPUs on this instance, and it includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the high memory-to-vCPU ratio of over 10:1, this server is designed for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. The qualitative cost profile reflects a high-density resource allocation suitable for large-scale databases, in-memory analytics, and heavy enterprise applications. The combination of dedicated compute cores, massive RAM, and local SSD storage makes it a fit for relational database management systems, large-scale caching layers, and enterprise resource planning systems.
